paragraphs: Genesis Educational Services makes administrative software for New Jersey school districts, sold as an integrated, paperless set of tools for daily operations and compliance. Its Student Information System is web-based and built to meet state requirements, including state reporting. A companion product, SchoolFi, handles business office work such as payroll, budgeting, HR and evaluations.

SchoolFi was created with input from business administrators, HR directors and payroll administrators who work in districts. Both products are backed by a help desk, an implementation team and a systems support department. The company says its software connects with Google Classroom and OneRoster.

The business began when Rick Smith and Rich Dilts set out to create a web-based student record system for K-12 school districts in New Jersey. Genesis says its Student Information System now supports over 280 school districts statewide. The company describes itself as serving more than half the schools in New Jersey and over 726,000 students.

quote.text: Behind every successful district is a system that runs smoothly in the background.
